# VoiceChat Pro - Full-Stack Web Application

This is a comprehensive real-time chat platform with voice analysis, video/audio calling, and advanced communication features.

## Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Project structure initialized
- [ ] Backend scaffolding complete
- [ ] Frontend scaffolding complete
- [ ] WebRTC and real-time communication setup
- [ ] Voice analysis features implemented
- [ ] Database configured
- [ ] Dependencies installed
- [ ] Project tested and running

## Project Structure

```
E-learning/
├── backend/              # Node.js/Express API server
├── frontend/             # React web application
├── shared/              # Shared types and utilities
├── docs/                # Documentation
└── .github/             # GitHub configuration
```

## Key Technologies

- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Socket.io
- **Communication**: WebRTC (peer-to-peer), Socket.io (signaling)
- **Voice Analysis**: TensorFlow.js, Web Audio API
- **Database**: MongoDB with Mongoose
- **Real-time**: Socket.io, WebRTC
- **Storage**: File upload support for videos/notes

## Features

1. **Real-time Chat**: Text messaging with emoji support
2. **Video/Audio Calling**: Peer-to-peer with WebRTC
3. **Voice Analysis**: Detect emotional state, fatigue, deception patterns
4. **Media Sharing**: Video notes, audio notes, file attachments
5. **User Management**: Authentication, profiles, status
6. **Contact Management**: Add friends, view online status

See backend/README.md and frontend/README.md for specific setup instructions.
